fusions.name: Pointed Quarry
fusions.desc: Fires a round into the first enemy in its path for 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pack Signal
fusions.desc: Fires a round at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. When it hits, your party deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Got Your Back
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Retriever
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded retriever that fights beside you within 4.5 tiles, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds; anything it strikes moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
